# Support

Choose the channel that matches the request:

- [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/concordloom/concordloom/discussions) — usage questions, early ideas, examples, and general conversation.
- [Bug report](https://github.com/concordloom/concordloom/issues/new?template=bug.yml) — a reproducible defect in Concord Loom.
- [Feature proposal](https://github.com/concordloom/concordloom/issues/new?template=feature.yml) — a concrete change with a clear use case and authority boundary.
- [Documentation issue](https://github.com/concordloom/concordloom/issues/new?template=documentation.yml) — unclear, incorrect, or mismatched English/Russian guidance.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md) — vulnerabilities and sensitive security reports.

Community support is provided on a best-effort basis. Opening an issue does not create a service-level commitment or imply that a proposal has been accepted.
